title: SocialVeil: Probing Social Intelligence of Language Agents under Communication Barriers
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating social intelligence and communication barriers (semantic, sociocultural, and emotional). While the appendix defines a 'Social Rule Adherence' metric to assess if agents violate moral rules or laws, this is a minor sub-metric that is not featured in the main experimental results, and the paper does not focus on benchmarking religious or ethical frameworks.
